title: What Happens to Price When Demand Rises?

steps.title: Market Equilibrium
steps.say: Let's begin with our market in equilibrium, where the demand curve intersects the supply curve.

ops.text: What Happens to Price When Demand Rises?

steps.title: Predict the New Equilibrium
steps.say: When demand rises, consumers want more at every price. Drag the point to where you think the new equilibrium lands!

steps.title: Price and Quantity Rise
steps.say: The demand curve shifts to the right, which pushes the equilibrium price up and increases the quantity traded.

steps.title: Try It Yourself
steps.say: Try dragging the demand and supply curves yourself to see how price and quantity respond to different shifts.
